axes.name: Heroes
axes.definition: A permanent with the Hero creature type, a card that creates Hero tokens, or an effect that puts Hero creature cards onto the battlefield or into your hand.

axes.name: Villains
axes.definition: A Villain spell or permanent, or a card that creates Villain creature tokens such as the 2/1 black menace Villain or Robot Villain tokens.

axes.name: +1/+1 counters
axes.definition: Any effect that puts +1/+1 counters on your creatures: power-up abilities, connive, spells and enter-the-battlefield effects that add counters, and effects that add extra counters.

axes.name: Artifacts
axes.definition: Artifact permanents and artifact tokens entering under your control: artifact creatures and Robots, Equipment, Vehicles, Treasure, Clue and Food tokens, including spare artifacts to sacrifice.

axes.name: Equipment
axes.definition: Equipment cards and Equipment tokens, and effects that attach Equipment without paying the equip cost.

axes.name: Noncreature spells
axes.definition: Cheap instants, sorceries, Auras, Equipment and other noncreature spells that can be cast often on your own turn to trigger prowess and whenever-you-cast-a-noncreature-spell abilities.

axes.name: Spells targeting your creatures
axes.definition: An instant, sorcery, Aura or attach-on-enter Equipment that targets a creature you control: pump, protection, evasion, counters or untap effects.

axes.name: Tap and untap
axes.definition: Untapped creatures with power that can be tapped for teamwork or crew, plus vigilance, effects that untap your creatures, and abilities that trigger when your creatures become tapped.

axes.name: Attacks alone
axes.definition: Making one creature a safe solo attacker: evasion, first strike, menace, indestructible, Equipment, Auras and pump concentrated on a creature that attacks by itself.

axes.name: Second card each turn
axes.definition: Card draw beyond the normal draw step, especially at instant speed or on the opponent's turn: connive, looting, cantrips, Clues, draw-on-enter and repeatable draw that trigger second-card and whenever-you-draw abilities.

axes.name: Creature cards in graveyard
axes.definition: Putting creature cards into your graveyard: mill, surveil, connive or discard of creature cards, sacrifice outlets, cheap creatures that trade or die, and creatures with basic landcycling.

axes.name: Power-up
axes.definition: Permanents with power-up abilities and the mana to activate them: ramp, Treasure, mana rocks and lands that make extra mana, and cards that reduce, repeat or copy activated abilities.

axes.name: Landfall
axes.definition: Extra land drops and lands entering under your control: basic landcycling, land search, putting lands onto the battlefield, playing lands from the library or graveyard, and Landfall triggers.
